title: Natural Language Inference by Tree-Based Convolution and Heuristic Matching
motivation: Existing neural methods fail to fully leverage syntactic info or suffer from long propagation paths in recursive networks
problem_framing: NLI as sentence pair classification via TBCNN sentence encoder + heuristic matching layers (concat, product, difference)
key_insight: Element-wise difference matching is mathematically reducible to concatenation but explicitly optimizing it yields 1-2% accuracy boost
method_signature: TBCNN-pair: tree-based convolution for sentence encoding + concatenation/product/difference matching heuristics
evaluation_criteria: Accuracy on SNLI benchmark; matching complexity O(1) vs O(n) vs O(n²) for alternatives
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Element-wise product alone performs significantly worse than concatenation or difference alone
